instruction: Copy the directory 'todo_list_Jan_1' on the Desktop to create a duplicate named 'todo_list_backup'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: if [ -d ~/Desktop/todo_list_backup ]; then if diff -r ~/Desktop/todo_list_Jan_1 ~/Desktop/todo_list_backup > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Directory copied successfully.'; else echo 'Directory exists but contents differ.'; fi; else echo 'Directory does not exist.'; fi

metadata.explanation: Task requires copying a directory to create a backup. Evaluator verifies the new directory exists and contains identical contents to the source directory using diff -r command. Uses existing exact_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies directory copy operation with complete semantic coverage
Command uses 'diff -r' to recursively compare all files and subdirectories between source (todo_list_Jan_1) and destination (todo_list_backup)

Three-tier verification logic: (1) checks if destination directory exists, (2) if exists, uses 'diff -r' to verify identical contents, (3) only outputs success message if both directories exist AND contents match exactly
Metric 'exact_match' correctly checks for 'Directory copied successfully.\n' which is only output when diff -r confirms identical contents
Evaluator can distinguish between: (1) directory not existing, (2) directory existing but with different/missing contents, (3) proper copy with identical contents
The nested if-statement logic ensures that an agent cannot pass verification by merely creating an empty directory or directory with different contents
